Office Hours

What are ‘office hours’? The best way to understand what office hours are really all about is to watch this explanatory video:

When and where: Mondays 10:30-11:30am; Tuesdays 2:30-3:30pm, 3908 Posvar

Office hours are your time! You do not need to email me in advance to let me know you are coming: just show up at my office door whenever you like during the time slot. You do not need to have a specific, or even course-related question: we can gossip about Pitt or debate the historicity of the latest Assassin’s Creed game.

Please try to make the designated time work for your schedule. But, if you can’t fit it in, send me an email (pickettj@pitt.edu) and we will figure something out.

Visits to discuss course content can also earn engagement points (see Grading Policies).
